plan.title: Proposal submission requires Supply / Service Scope

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS as required for prepared-state cases.
Enter the awarding screen so the line can be allocated before creating the proposal.
Allocate the available prepared line to the available vendor; the exact quantity and Vendor B cannot be selected in this prepared state.
Create the draft proposal form after allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.

args.goal: On the proposal page, fill every required proposal field except Supply / Service Scope, leave Supply / Service Scope empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop when the required-field validation is shown.

steps.note: Complete the proposal form while deliberately leaving Supply / Service Scope blank, then submit to exercise the requested validation.
Assert that the empty field is highlighted with the required-field validation and submission is refused.
